job.question: Which retirement system's investment consultant RFP requires firms to certify that they currently provide investment consulting services to clients whose combined assets total at least $50 billion?
job.expected_facts: Teachers' Retirement System of the State of Illinois (TRS Illinois), in its FY23 investment consultant RFP (Appendix B, Statement of Minimum Qualifications).
job.acceptance: TRS Illinois / Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois is sufficient; FY23 and appendix identifier are optional.

reviews.reason: This is a Boston Retirement System RFP, not a TRS Illinois RFP. Its stated minimum qualifications concern years of experience, not a certification that firms currently advise clients with combined assets of at least $50 billion.
quotes: BOSTON RETIREMENT SYSTEM (“BRS”) INVESTMENT CONSULTING SERVICES REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS (“RFP”)
Does the Prospective Consultant firm have at least three (3) years of experience performing substantially similar services for institutional clients?
Does the prospective “lead Consultant” on the BRS account have at least five (5) years of experience advising systems of similar size and scope to BRS
